######Today 13 December 2025######

It's been 5 days now, and my Mahindra XUV 3XO TGDI AX5L petrol car is at the Mahindra dealership, Harbir Automobiles in Chandigarh, due to a cruise control malfunction.  However, the dealership and Mahindra technicians are unable to fix the problem. I have shown videos to various managers and technicians multiple times and even given a live demonstration of the issue, but they have no solution.  No one has reported this yet, but I suspect this problem might be present in the entire batch of cars. This issue has been present since the day I took delivery in July 2024, and I reported it every time I visited the dealership, but they just fobbed me off with software updates or flashing the system.

Today, on the fifth day, they came again for a test drive, but the problem is still not fixed. Now I don't know if it was a test drive or a driving test for my driving skills.

They are not giving me any timeline or commitment for the delivery of my car after the repairs.

Many more experiences of worst service of the dealership...

I am extremely grateful for the outstanding support and service provided by my health insurance broker, Babita Agarwal. From the very beginning, she has been nothing short of exceptional in helping me navigate the challenges of my medical claim and ensuring I received the refund I was entitled to.
After I had already submitted all the necessary documents to the insurance company, I encountered significant delays and difficulties. The insurer was being uncooperative, and I struggled to get clear answers regarding the status of my claim. That's when Babita Agarwal stepped in. She quickly took charge, reviewing all the documents I had already submitted, and identified areas where the insurer was stalling or lacking clarity.
Her proactive approach was a game changer. She liaised directly with the insurance company on my behalf, following up regularly and pushing for a resolution. Whenever I had questions or concerns, she was always available to offer guidance and provide reassurance. Thanks to her persistence and expertise, I was able to overcome the roadblocks and finally receive the refund I was owed.
I truly felt supported throughout the entire process, and I know I wouldn't have been able to navigate the complexities of my claim without her assistance. Babita Agarwal is not only highly knowledgeable but also genuinely cares about her clients' well-being. I highly recommend her services to anyone looking for a reliable and dedicated insurance broker

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience with Rohit  (Rohcen) from Rurash Financial Ltd. He has guided me exceptionally well in selecting the right mutual funds based on my financial goals.

His in-depth knowledge of mutual funds and financial planning really helped me make confident investment decisions. He explained everything in a very simple and clear manner, which made the entire process smooth and easy to understand.

Apart from mutual funds, he also guided me on the importance of proper insurance planning and how investing in the right places can help in long-term wealth creation. His approach is practical, transparent, and completely focused on client benefit.

What I appreciate the most is his constant support and availability whenever guidance is needed. He genuinely cares about his clients and always ensures that investments are done in the right direction.

I would highly recommend Rohit  (Rohcen) to anyone looking for reliable financial guidance, investment planning, and wealth creation.

Thank you Rohit for your continuous support!

featured_reviews.name: dr.yunus sumra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my sincere appreciation to Rurash Finance, especially Mr. Aniket, for his exceptional dedication and professionalism in helping me convert my old physical shares into demat form.

The process was extremely complicated, with several hurdles such as name mismatch, address changes, and other documentation issues. At one point, I had almost lost hope that the shares could ever be recovered.

However, Mr. Aniket worked tirelessly on this matter for nearly 15 months. His agent made multiple visits to my home, coordinated everything from his office, and handled all the procedures with the concerned government authorities. Because of his persistent effort, the entire work was completed successfully, and I did not have to visit any government office even once.

His patience, honesty, and commitment to solving the problem were truly remarkable. I highly recommend Rurash Finance to anyone facing similar issues with old physical shares. Thank you for the outstanding service.

featured_reviews.name: Mohan K
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had taken services from Rurash for dematerialisation of physical shares that belonged to my deceased father. The case was complicated that involved IEPF, suspension, Transmission and many more. But Rurash handled this professionally and with great patience.
Also acknowledging the good work by Swapna who consistently coordinated with RTA and DMAT on my behalf with prompt responses and excellent support.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Jaggia
featured_reviews.review_text: I used them to dmat my 30+ year old shares stuck in iepf. They did a pretty thorough job. It took about 2 years but the staff was very straight forward and always available. I interacted with 3 persons over this period as it seems there is a lot of churn but all staff was good starting from Khusboo to Austin and then Sayali, who is particularly aggressive in not just following up for my shares but also on pushing me for payments. They are expensive but recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Bandi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had taken services from Rurash Financials for dematerialisation of physical shares that belonged to my various family members. All the cases were complicated and needed constant correspondence with RTA. But Rurash Financials handled this professionally and with great patience.

We also acknowledge the good work by Mr. Aniket who consistently coordinated with RTA and DMAT on our behalf with prompt responses and excellent support. With his timely and consistent follow-ups, the DMATs of all the shares have been possible.  We are happy with the services offered by Rurash Financials and strongly recommend them to all.
